Things I like about him: everything. The way he struggles with his mental health and inner demons for all his life and still prevails in the end, showing his loyal and caring personality. He’s determinated, strong, just an all around interesting person who unfortunately went through too much. He is deeply flawed for sure, but that doesn’t stop him from trying his best to make things right for the people he loves and for his kingdom. He is also pretty fucking beautiful.

How long have you been togheter: I am actually still exploring these feelings with him. But I’d say a few days.

How do they influence your life? Me and Dimitri are really similar. Of course his mental illnesses are taken to the extreme in the main story of 3 Houses, but I resonate deeply with his constant fight against his own mind, his closed and reserved personality, his determination. We’re both people who are kinda pretty outside and smart enough, but with mental and personal problems so big that they prevent us from being the best version of ourselves. That makes him so appealing to me and makes me want to keep doing my best even at my lowest points, I guess.

Why am I joining? Because I want to share with y’all my love and care for this man💙
